title: Observe the selected committed head without comparison layers
preconditions: A committed source checkout contains a valid Saga and a known head H.

steps.action: Read status without --against at default HEAD.
steps.expected_result: Mode is observe, comparison layers are absent, and changed-line total is zero.

steps.action: Repeat with --head H selecting an older committed head.
steps.expected_result: The reported head is H, mode is observe, and layers and changed-line total remain empty.

expected_result: The reported head is H, mode is observe, and layers and changed-line total remain empty.
